conviction_note: Q3 2026 results are new and Bouvet never gives guidance. The company-level drivers point to EBIT up on last year (weak Q3 2025 comparison: EBIT NOK 91.6m, billing ratio -2.1pp; same 66 working days; headcount +2.8%, hourly rates +2.3% and a billing ratio rising through Q2), but the bar is unsourced, peers' read-through was already bought (+7.2% on 23 Oct on Knowit's 'Norge utvecklas starkt'), and the stock is +15% over 20 days into a name that sold three of its last four prints. So p_up sits only slightly above 50 (53), while abs_move stays large (6.0) because of the last four results-day moves (-8.2, -9.7, -4.4, +16.4) and thin turnover. The findings sum (+1.2) exceeds the scaled number (+0.36) because each finding is sized alone and capped for the unsourced bar, while the run-up and the name's habit of selling prints weigh only on p_up.

findings.finding: Q3 2025 is a weak comparison (EBIT NOK 91.6m at 10.5% margin, billing ratio 2.1pp lower YoY, average headcount -0.8%), Q3 2026 has the same 66 working days, and Q2 2026 left Q3 with own-employee fee income +3.8%, hourly rates +2.3%, headcount +2.8% YoY, a billing ratio 'rising throughout the quarter' and new contracts (Mapping Authority, starting 'this autumn'; Barentswatch; Sokkeldirektoratet Faktavarehus 2.0 on 31 Aug). On that arithmetic EBIT is likely up year on year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026, flat revenue with a rising billing ratio and EBIT flat at 12.5%: +16.4%. Q1 2026, billing ratio -1.8pp: -4.4%. Q4 2025: -9.7%. Q3 2025, billing ratio -2.1pp and EBIT -9%: -8.2%. The quarter's operating line moves this stock 4-16%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is +22.8% over 60 days and +15.2% over 20, which is what a market expecting YoY growth looks like. What is not priced is the size. The bar is unsourced and the billing ratio is not disclosed until the release, so the gap to the 91.6m comparison is unknown in either direction. Capped small for the unsourced bar.
findings.independence: Peer statements below (Knowit, Netcompany) are a different source pointing the same way; Q3 2025 drivers from https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/attachment?messageId=659260&attachmentId=314314

findings.finding: Nordic peers that reported after Bouvet's Q2 described Norway as strong. Knowit's Q3 release (23 Oct): 'Norge utvecklas starkt'. Netcompany's Q3 release (29 Oct): 'we saw growth in all markets'. BOUV rose 7.2% on 23 Oct on about 5x normal volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior peer-read reaction measured; the 23 Oct move (+7.2%, 553k shares against a ~100k median) shows the stock trading on this read-through already.
findings.original_quote: Norge utvecklas starkt (Norway is developing strongly)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the same-day +7.2% on 5x volume shows the market read it. Kept small because it is a peer-to-company inference (a proxy) and the price has visibly absorbed it.

findings.finding: Atea's Q3 2026 services sales fell 1.9% YoY (22 Oct). Growth was hardware-led, which is a soft read on Nordic IT services labour demand.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: not measured; Atea is an infrastructure reseller, not a consultancy peer
findings.why_not_priced: It is a narrow proxy that loses to the direct consultancy peers (Knowit's Norway comment) and to Bouvet's own Q2 trajectory. BOUV did not fall on 22 Oct (-0.7%). Sized near zero.

findings.finding: The AGM of 13 May 2026 authorised the board to pay an additional dividend on the 2025 accounts until the next AGM. Bouvet used the same authorisation at Q3 2025 (NOK 0.70 announced with the Q3 release), so a supplementary dividend is possible on 4 Nov. Low cash (NOK 159.7m at Q2) argues against it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 carried the NOK 0.70 supplementary dividend and the stock still fell 8.2% on the EBIT decline, so the line has not dominated a reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: No broker or wire item anticipates a 2026 supplementary payment. If it were expected, the precedent would be quoted in previews; none were found. Sized small: it is unlikely given low cash, and a NOK 0.5-0.7 payout is about 1% of spot.

findings.finding: Operating cash flow and liquidity are structurally weaker in 2026 because the dedicated tax-deduction account was discontinued (H1 2026 operating cash flow -103.1m against -28.5m; cash 159.7m against 383.5m), so Q3 cash flow will compare badly with Q3 2025 (12.2m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 printed -54.6m operating cash flow for the same reason and the stock rose 16.4%, so the market has looked through it once.
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the company explained the mechanism in Q2 and holders looked through it. Kept as a small negative because it constrains the capital-return line above.
